text_block_list.text:
I see Мэдзиро Райан in front of the stairs,
trembling.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ah, T-Trainer... I did too much weight
with my leg
presses yesterday...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
A-as you can see, my muscles are aching
mighty
hard right now. But don't worry!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text: This is proof that they're growing!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан
choice_data_list: Are you going to be okay for today's training?

text_block_list.text: Oh, yeah! No problem! I'm just—
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Райан

text_block_list.text:
Perhaps due to her sore muscles, Mejiro
Ryan isn't
able to get into a rhythm
during her training.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
